cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 and D2 and contract opencode-2x-belt (decision 42af3b4f). Facts from the opencode 2.2.5 binary (static read 2026-11-19): the loader accepts only default {id, effect} or {id, setup}; setup(api) may return a cleanup function; a setup plugin subscribes with api.tool.hook('execute.before', fn) and fn receives {tool, sessionID, agent, messageID, id, input}; the arguments are in input and a hook may assign input; a throw inside the hook is caught and becomes the tool error; write, edit and read take path, patch keeps patchText, shell keeps command; the 1.x ids bash, task, apply_patch became shell, subagent, patch. 2.x still scans .opencode/plugins. Before writing, start opencode 1.18.16 (npx -y opencode-ai@1.18.16, run under .bee/tmp/oc11816) and the installed 2.2.5 with a probe file to settle how each runtime treats a default export of the other shape; pick one file or two files so that neither runtime fails to start and each loads exactly its own guard; record the probe result in the cap report. Keep one rule core (binary resolution, runBlockingHook, mapToolCall) that both entries use; if two files, the 2.x entry imports the core from the 1.x file or a shared module that opencode does not load as a plugin, and onboard (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/plan.rs list_opencode_plugin_files) installs every file the belt needs. Add harness tests in opencode_plugin_contracts.rs per the contract, reusing run_harness and write_stub_bee. Update the registry gate so shell, patch and subagent count as mapped on 2.x. Write no code comment. Run only the verify command, never the full suite. After the change run bee dev regen so the release manifest is current, and commit it. Commit once with the cell trailer.
